items:
🏦 **Commercial & Public Sector Banks:**
• **ICICI Bank:** Sandeep Bakhshi re-appointed MD & CEO.
• **Canara Bank:** Hardeep Singh Ahluwalia appointed MD & CEO.
• **IndusInd Bank:** Arijit Basu appointed Chairman (succeeding Sunil Mehta).
• **YES Bank:** Vinay Muralidhar Tonse appointed MD & CEO.
• **AU Small Finance Bank:** Sanjay Agarwal re-appointed MD & CEO.
• **HDFC Bank:** Keki Mistry appointed Interim Part-Time Chairman.

🏛️ **Regulatory Bodies & Apex Institutions:**
• **SEBI Whole-Time Members (WTMs):** K.V. Ramana Murthy, Kamlesh Chandra Varshney, Sandip Pradhan, and Amarjeet Singh appointed WTMs.
• **GIFT City:** Uday Kotak appointed Chairman (succeeding Hasmukh Adhia).
• **NITI Aayog:** Nidhi Chhibber appointed Interim CEO.
• **ICAI:** CA Prasanna Kumar D elected 74th President for 2026-27.

🎖️ **Defence & Diplomatic Leadership:**
• **Vice Chief of Army Staff:** Lt Gen Dheeraj Seth appointed VCOAS.
• **Ambassador to China:** Vikram Doraiswami named India’s Ambassador to China.
• **High Commissioner to UK:** Periasamy Kumaran appointed High Commissioner.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Uday Kotak (GIFT City Chairman), Keki Mistry (HDFC Bank Interim Chairman), Hardeep Singh Ahluwalia (Canara Bank MD&CEO).
